channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Oil drops more than 3% as U.S. shifts to economic pressure on Iran, easing fears of renewed war
item.description: Investors shrugged off the latest developments in the U.S.-Iran war.

item.title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await key inflation report, Nvidia earnings: Live updates
item.description: Traders awaited inflation data along with Nvidia's latest quarterly results. Both are due Wednesday.

item.title: OpenAI data center chief Chris Malone is out, the latest in a string of executive exits
item.description: An OpenAI spokesperson said the company "recently reorganized our infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."

item.title: Nvidia's 'expectations premium' dogs the stock after earnings. Here's what analysts are watching
item.description: Over the past year, Nvidia has topped estimates on all the topline metrics and has still been punished by investors the next trading day.

item.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
item.description: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.

item.title: Stanley Druckenmiller leads doubters who think Bessent's bond ploys will fail
item.description: The bond market interventions have generated a modest decline in yields along with a growing chorus of derision.

item.title: Dolly Parton, queen of country music, dies at 80
item.description: With songs such as "Coat of Many Colors," "Jolene" and "I Will Always Love You," she was one of the best-selling female artists of all time.

item.title: SpaceX plans to build a $100 billion spaceport in Louisiana
item.description: SpaceX plans to establish its Starbase, LA in Vermilion Parish, which will "support thousands of launches annually."

item.title: Is the K-shaped economy ending? Finance pros weigh in
item.description: The K-shaped economy may be changing. New data shows income and spending gaps are narrowing — but household finances tell a more complicated story.

item.title: Here's why markets are starting to care about the 2026 election 10 weeks out
item.description: Wall Street analysts are tuning in 10 weeks ahead of the Nov. 3 election with concerns about risks to investors depending on how the U.S. results turn out.

item.title: Cash is no longer king in home sales
item.description: Cash buyers are a diminishing share of the overall housing market, as more supply and weaker prices give all buyers more purchasing power.

item.title: Investor competition for commercial real estate sees strongest growth in a year
item.description: Even though macro uncertainty and volatility continue to show up in the broader economy, bidding keeps rising, according to JLL.

item.title: Dick’s Sporting Goods just had its worst day ever. Here's Jim Cramer's advice on the stock now
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors shouldn’t give up on Dick’s after its record 30% plunge.

item.title: 'Big Short' investor Danny Moses calls 10-year yield, Nvidia the two most important assets for markets right now
item.description: The two assets are the center of gravity in financial markets at the moment, according to the Moses Ventures founder.

item.title: Bond rout ending? Massive bets on bond rally dominate options market
item.description: There's an old Wall Street adage: Stocks float on a sea of bonds. Options traders are betting the tide is going out.

item.title: Kalshi traders see low likelihood of major crypto bill becoming law this year
item.description: The White House has pushed for Congress to pass the Clarity Act, a bill on crypto regulation. Kalshi traders see little chance the bill becomes law this year.

item.title: HHS plans new FDA deputy commissioner roles for technology and drugs, sources say
item.description: HHS plans to name two deputy commissioners for technology and drugs, said two sources familiar with the matter.

item.title: Trump goes all in on Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina, as primary losses pile up
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham squares off Tuesday against Rep. Ralph Norman in a bid to win the GOP nomination for the a South Carolina Senate seat.

item.title: Apple announces new Mac Mini and Mac Studio models with AI upgrades
item.description: "With these frameworks and new chips, developers can run and fine-tune large AI models locally on their Mac," Apple said.

item.title: Waymo to launch driverless rides in Germany in 2027, entering third market outside U.S.
item.description: Waymo has been the biggest robotaxi player in the U.S., and has announced plans to enter the U.K., Japan and now Germany.

item.title: 2 of our software stocks face major tests of whether their rallies are for real
item.description: Here are the questions we are looking to answer when CrowdStrike and Salesforce report earnings Wednesday evening.

item.title: It's officially pumpkin spice latte season. Here are 4 great credit cards to use at Starbucks
item.description: PSL fans are out of their gourd. Here's how to get rewarded for ordering your favorite fall beverage.

item.title: The 'debasement trade' returns after Bessent bond maneuver. Crypto and gold are back in style
item.description: Concern over the size and the cost of U.S. government spending has given new life to the debasement trade.

item.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls 30% as retailer misses expectations, cites 'challenging' footwear market
item.description: Dick's Sporting Goods reported fiscal second-quarter earnings on Tuesday that missed Wall Street expectations amid what it called a "challenging" environment.

item.title: Are you richer than you think? How to find out—and what experts say to do if you are
item.description: States are holding billions of dollars in unclaimed property, and some of it may be yours.

item.title: China needs U.S. dollars but is building a hedge against Washington’s sanctions
item.description: The U.S. can pressure Chinese banks over Iran through access to its financial system, while Beijing is building alternatives such as CIPS.

item.title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it
item.description: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

item.title: World Liberty Financial CEO Zach Witkoff says success of stablecoin silences charge of Trump cronyism
item.description: Zach Witkoff, CEO of Trump-linked World Liberty Financial, said conflict-of-interest concerns related to the Trump family are misplaced.

item.title: Bitcoin price extends gains, briefly tops $81,000 as crypto rally gathers pace
item.description: Bitcoin briefly surged past $81,000 as renewed inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs and improving risk appetite extended the recent crypto rally.

item.title: Nvidia’s dependence on hyperscalers faces big test in earnings report
item.description: Nvidia is trying to expand its customer base by creating new financing options that allow for more clients to purchase its costly systems.
